gbm_population_evidence.quote: Neoplasms; Glioblastoma, Adult; Small Cell Lung Carcinoma (SCLC)
Cohort 2: Recurrent or progressive glioblastoma confirmed by histopathology or imaging, which has progressed or recurred after at least one prior treatment with temozolomide.

candidate_evidence.quote: This trial is a single-arm, open-label, first-in-human study of CS231295, comprising two phases: dose escalation (including single-dose and multiple-dose) and cohort expansion.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Have histologically or cytologically confirmed unresectable advanced, recurrent, or metastatic solid tumors

role_evidence.quote: CS231295: oral tablet. Only one dose on C0D1 in single-dose period.

agents.drug_class_hint: investigational oral small molecule CS231295 (first-in-human; possibly Aurora kinase inhibitor given exclusion of prior Aurora kinase inhibitors)

coder_notes: First-in-human solid-tumour basket; glioblastoma named in conditions, inclusion criteria and as expansion Cohort 2 (recurrent GBM after temozolomide). PK planned (Tmax, Cmax, AUC etc.) with no sample type stated -> tumour_pk_planned unclear per W7 (almost certainly plasma). Mechanism not stated in record; the Aurora kinase hint is inferred only from an exclusion criterion. Plain 'glioblastoma' -> cns5 unclear.
